newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end mixed ahead of JR West listing.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end mixed ahead of JR West listing.

text.p: Tokyo stock price indices closed mixed on Monday after moving in narrow ranges and languishing at weaker levels for most of the day, shrugging off a surge on Wall Street.
Brokers said participants retreated to the sidelines ahead of the long-awaited listing of West Japan Railway Co, which is due to take place on Tuesday.
They also said movements in Tokyo stocks would be restrained for the time being until the nation's political framework becomes clearer following general elections on October 20.
The market's key 225-share Nikkei 225 average closed up 12.98 points or 0.06 percent at 21,161.01. In the stock futures market, the benchmark December futures contract was up 30 points at 21,200.
